hooks.command: c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qE 'gitnexus(@[^ ]+)?[[:space:]]+analyze' && ! printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qE -- '--(skip-agents-md|index-only)'; then echo 'hexlog: run `gitnexus analyze --skip-agents-md`. Without the flag it injects a gitnexus block into AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md.' >&2; exit 2; fi
